export function createSemaphore(concurrency) {
  const queue = [];
  let active = 0;
  const next = () => {
    if (queue.length === 0) return;
    const { fn, resolve, reject } = queue.shift();
    active++;
    fn().then(resolve, reject).finally(() => {
      active--;
      next();
    });
  };
  const sem = {
    run(fn) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        if (active < concurrency) {
          active++;
          fn().then(resolve, reject).finally(() => {
            active--;
            next();
          });
        } else {
          queue.push({ fn, resolve, reject });
        }
      });
    },
    get active() {
      return active;
    }
  };
  return sem;
}
export const defaultHttpPolicy = {
  defaultTimeoutMs: 3e4,
  globalConcurrency: 8,
  domainConcurrency: 4,
  maxRetries: 2,
  retryableStatuses: [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
  baseRetryDelayMs: 300,
  maxRetryDelayMs: 8e3,
  maxRetryAfterMs: 1e4,
  timeoutByPrefix: {}
};
let policy = { ...defaultHttpPolicy };
let globalGate = null;
const domainGates = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
export function getHttpPolicy() {
  return policy;
}
export function setHttpPolicy(p) {
  policy = { ...policy, ...p };
  resetGates();
}
export function resetHttpPolicy() {
  policy = { ...defaultHttpPolicy };
  resetGates();
}
function resetGates() {
  globalGate = null;
  domainGates.clear();
}
function domainOf(path) {
  const seg = path.split("/").filter(Boolean).find((p) => p !== "api");
  return seg || "root";
}
export function runWithGate(path, fn) {
  const gate = globalGate ??= createSemaphore(policy.globalConcurrency);
  const dom = domainOf(path);
  let dgate = domainGates.get(dom);
  if (!dgate) {
    dgate = createSemaphore(policy.domainConcurrency);
    domainGates.set(dom, dgate);
  }
  return gate.run(() => dgate.run(fn));
}
